title: The Silent Pandemic: Understanding Antimicrobial Resistance
subtitle: An in-depth look at the global crisis of drug-resistant infections and the future of modern medicine.
description: Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) threatens to undo a century of medical progress. This series examines the scientific, economic, and policy dimensions of this global health challenge.

articles.label: Part 1
articles.note: Explaining the biological mechanism of resistance and the historical context of antibiotic discovery.

articles.label: Part 2
articles.note: Identifying the roles of pharmaceutical companies, agricultural sectors, and international health bodies.

articles.label: Part 3
articles.note: Examining recent international agreements and the 'One Health' approach.

articles.label: Part 4
articles.note: The impact of drug-resistant infections on healthcare systems and global productivity.

articles.label: Part 5
articles.note: Emerging technologies and the future of infection control.
